_comment: Tier-2: UPl element Initialize reads exotic nodal historical variables; a minimal nodal-variable list crashes inside C++. Pitfall (kratos.poromechanics #4). Executed on Kratos 10.4.3 (pip wheels, glibc-2.31 host, fresh venv on external ext4 image). Every variable the claim lists resolves on PoromechanicsApplication and NOT on core: INITIAL_STRESS_TENSOR, NODAL_EFFECTIVE_STRESS_TENSOR, NODAL_MID_PLANE_LIQUID_PRESSURE, NODAL_SLIP_TENDENCY, NODAL_JOINT_DAMAGE, DT_LIQUID_PRESSURE, NORMAL_LIQUID_FLUX, LIQUID_DISCHARGE. Assembling the AddVariables list therefore requires the Poromechanics module by name; none of these can be dotted off KratosMultiphysics. The fixture imports KratosMultiphysics at module scope; with Kratos absent the import raises, the process exits non-zero and the runner records a failure, never a pass.
